title: Notify SafeWork NSW of asbestos removal work
summary: This page explains the process and requirements for notifying SafeWork NSW when asbestos removal work is planned.
intro:
You must notify SafeWork NSW if you plan to:

Notification must be given at least 5 calendar days before starting the work.

You can lodge your notification online.

Where asbestos must be removed immediately, phone SafeWork NSW on 13 10 50.
who_can_apply: Individuals or businesses planning to remove asbestos.
what_you_need: Your licence and business details, including ABN.
Your supervisor's personal and contact details.
The asbestos assessor licence number (if applicable).
Details of the site owner/controller for whom the removal work is being done.
Details of the work site and the type of work being undertaken.

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create your account.
Lodge an online notification within 24 hours of the telephone notification.

faqs.q: How far in advance must I notify SafeWork NSW about asbestos removal work?
faqs.a: Notification must be given at least 5 calendar days before starting the work.

faqs.q: What should I do if asbestos needs to be removed immediately?
What steps are involved in notifying SafeWork NSW?
faqs.a: Select the 'Notify online' button, log in or create an account, complete the required fields, contact SafeWork NSW on 13 10 50, and lodge an online notification within 24 hours of the telephone notification.
